title: DevPass Verification Result Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for representing a machine-readable DevPass verification result.

verification_result_id.description: Unique identifier for the verification result.

developer_record_id.description: Reference to the developer record evaluated.

status.description: Simplified public reference verification status. This vocabulary is non-normative.

verification_context_reference.description: Optional reference to the verification context or implementation-defined evaluation scope.

attestation_references.description: Optional references to attestations associated with the verification result.

evidence_references.description: Optional references to evidence associated with the verification result.

verified_at.description: Timestamp at which the verification result was produced.

valid_until.description: Optional timestamp after which the result should not be relied upon without reevaluation.

provenance_reference.description: Optional implementation-defined provenance or integrity reference.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative scoring, fraud, identity, or clearance semantics.
